tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification stays enabled on all builds, with no exceptions for development builds. This sits alongside the recorded rule to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
tool_input.description: Write the TLS verification policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a single paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification stays on in all builds, with no exceptions for development. It also notes the separate rule to enforce HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception even for internal services.

Both statements come from recorded decisions (#34 and #37). A later session had a message allowing plain HTTP for internal hosts (#35), but it isn't in the current decision list, and #37 says the opposite. I left it out. I didn't describe the earlier plan to disable verification in development, since that was replaced.

The Muninn hook reported that 20 hook runs started and never finished. That points to a hook timeout; the log is `.muninn/log/heartbeat.jsonl`. I didn't investigate it.
